item: article_links gains the covering index (article_id, normalized_url) that convergence._shared_origin reads from, built by the visible start-up step (R455, R611)
summary: idx_article_link_article_url: model, migration a7c3e5f19b20 (down b3d8f1a6c4e2) and a DEFERRED self-heal entry, built by the article-indexes start-up step after the article list's two (never inside init_db), with its own free-space and memory figures (BYTES_PER_LINK 300, RAM_BYTES_PER_LINK 250: measured 67 and 104 bytes a link at 54-character urls) and its own words (4 keys x12, AI-drafted, native review). Measured on 4.16 M links, cold cache, 400 ids: SQLCipher with scattered links 1,392 -> 171 ms (the old two-scan shape was 1,946 ms); SQLite 3.45.1 67 -> 41 ms, 3.53.1 75 -> 35 ms, same COVERING INDEX plan; build 13.2 s SQLCipher, 3.3 s plain. A group refused for room or memory does not hold the other back. Limits: the job's label still reads as the article list's; the field's 32-55 s was not reproduced, so the gain on that machine is not promised.
